title: Sagittarius: your 2027,
month by month.
summary: Home first, then luck comes back. The five chapters of a Sagittarius year, what each month is for, and the dates to know.
imageAlt: Maya holding a Sagittarius flag, with a small archer beside her
inside: The year in five chapters, each with what to do and what to avoid
Work, love, money, energy and home, one by one
All twelve months, with your best months marked
The dates that matter, and why the year reads this way
intro: If you are a Sagittarius by Moon sign, 2027 is a year of roots and then horizons. For most of it the planet of patience sits in your house of home and family, and the tradition reads that as a year to sort out where you live and who you build your life around.

Your own ruling planet, the planet of luck, spends the first half of the year in your house of deep change, a quiet reset, and then comes back to your house of luck from late June to late November. That second stretch, with travel, teachers and big ideas, is read as the best part of your year. The year ends with luck rising into your house of career.

chapters.name: Wide open
chapters.text: The year opens with luck in your house of luck itself, as it has been since late October 2026. Travel, study, teachers and big plans all feel easy for these three weeks. At the same time the planet of patience sits in your house of home, so the call to sort out your base is already there in the background.
chapters.do: Book the trip or sign up for the course while the door is open.
chapters.avoid: Ignoring the home matter that keeps asking for your attention.

chapters.name: Going deep
chapters.text: Luck dives into your house of deep change: research, shared money, hidden matters and inner change. The tradition reads this as a private, transforming stretch rather than a public one. With the planet of patience still in your house of home, this is a good time to deal with what sits underneath: old family patterns, joint finances, the things you do not usually talk about.
chapters.do: Sort out one joint or family money matter properly, and give yourself quiet time.
chapters.avoid: Expecting outside recognition in these months. The work now is inside.

chapters.name: Home eases, joy gets serious
chapters.text: The planet of patience steps out of your house of home and into your house of joy, romance, children and creative work. Home asks less of you, and love and creativity start to ask for commitment instead. It is a short bridge of about three weeks before luck comes back.
chapters.do: Notice which relationship or creative project you want to take seriously.
chapters.avoid: Treating a serious mood in love as a bad sign. It is read as depth.

chapters.name: Luck comes home
chapters.text: Luck returns to your house of luck, teachers, travel and big ideas, and this is read as the best stretch of your year. Long journeys, study, publishing, faith and mentors are all well supported. Until October 18 the planet of patience is in your house of joy, so romance and creative work deepen; from October 19 it is back in your house of home, so you return to the nest with more to bring to it.
chapters.do: Travel, learn, teach, and say yes to the big idea you have been holding back.
chapters.avoid: Spreading yourself over so many plans that none of them lands.

chapters.name: A strong finish
chapters.text: Luck moves into your house of career and public life. The tradition reads this as a strong end to the year for work, reputation and recognition. Home is still asking for steady care, so the shape of December is a busy public life on top of a base you have spent the year fixing.
chapters.do: Put your work forward, ask for the role, and plan the working year ahead.
chapters.avoid: Letting the home routines you built slip in the rush.

allYear: All year a hungry influence sits in your house of money and speech, read as a big appetite to earn and to speak your mind. Use it to build income on purpose, and choose your words with care.

areas.name: Work and career
areas.text: Quiet for the first half, with your energy going into deeper, private work. From late November luck enters your house of career, which is read as a strong finish for reputation and recognition.

areas.name: Love and relationships
areas.text: June to October brings the planet of patience into your house of joy and romance, read as love getting serious. Commitments made then are said to be built to last. Luck in your house of teachers from late June also brings meaningful people.

areas.name: Money
areas.text: A strong drive to earn runs through the year. The first half also brings shared money and joint matters into focus. This is a reading of the sky, not financial advice: keep joint matters clear and in writing.

areas.name: Energy and wellbeing
areas.text: The first half is inward and reflective, so rest and quiet time restore you. The second half is busier and more outward. A steady home routine is what carries you through both.

areas.name: Home and family
areas.text: This is the centre of your year for most of it. Repairs, a move, family duties or putting down roots somewhere are all read as part of the work. Done slowly and properly, the tradition says it lasts.

areas.name: Travel and learning
areas.text: Late June to late November is your best window for long journeys, study and finding a teacher. January also supports it. This is the part of the year where your world gets bigger.

months.text: Luck is in your house of journeys and teachers until the 23rd. Plan a trip or a course. From the 24th the mood turns quieter and more private.
A deep, private month. Good for sorting out shared money, research, and the things underneath. Home also asks for steady attention. Take it one step at a time.
Keep the focus inward. Deal with one family pattern or joint matter you have been avoiding. Quiet time restores you more than a busy diary. Take it one step at a time.
A good month to look honestly at what you want to change. Work on your home base continues. Small private changes now set up a bigger second half.
The last full month of the inward stretch. Finish the home or family matter you started, and make space for a lighter, busier summer. Take it one step at a time.
On the 2nd home eases and love and creative work turn serious. On the 25th luck comes back to your house of journeys and teachers. A month that opens up.
One of your best months. Travel, study, meet teachers, and take a big idea seriously. Love and creative work deepen at the same time. Take it one step at a time.
The horizon is wide. A good month for long journeys, learning and sharing what you believe. Commit to the relationship or project you care about most.
Luck keeps supporting study, travel and mentors. Romance stays serious and real. Use this month to build something you will be proud of. Take it one step at a time.
Still lucky for journeys and big ideas. On the 19th the focus returns to home and family. Bring back what you learned and put it into your base.
Luck stays in your house of journeys until the 25th. From the 26th it rises into your house of career, and the month ends with work in the spotlight.
A strong month for work and reputation. Put your work forward and plan the year ahead, while keeping the home routines you built this year. Take it one step at a time.

dates.text: Luck moves into your house of deep change. The quiet reset begins.
Home eases; love and creative work turn serious until October 18.
Luck returns to your house of journeys and teachers. Your best stretch begins.
The focus returns to home and family for the rest of the year.
Luck rises into your house of career for a strong finish.

why.name: Jupiter, your sign's ruler
why.text: Jupiter rules Sagittarius. It is in Leo, your ninth house of luck, until January 23. It moves into Cancer, your eighth house of deep change, from January 24 to June 24. It returns to Leo from June 25 to November 25, then enters Virgo, your tenth house of career.

why.name: Saturn, the planet of patience and effort
why.text: Saturn is in Pisces, your fourth house of home and family, from January 1 to June 1 and again from October 19. From June 2 to October 18 it moves forward into Aries, your fifth house of joy, romance and creative work.

why.name: Rahu and Ketu, the Moon's nodes
why.text: Rahu moved into Capricorn, your second house of money and speech, on December 5, 2026, and stays there all of 2027. Ketu sits opposite in Cancer, your eighth house, which adds to the year's pull toward inner change.

faq.q: Is this for my Sun sign or my Moon sign?
faq.a: Your Moon sign. Vedic astrology reads timing from the sign the Moon was in when you were born, which is often different from the Sun sign most people know.

faq.q: I'm a Sagittarius Sun. Does this apply to me?
faq.a: Only if your Moon is also in Sagittarius. Many people with a Sagittarius Sun have their Moon somewhere else. Your birth chart shows it in a few seconds.
They are calculated from the planets' real positions, in US Eastern time, and they are the same for everyone with this Moon sign. What they mean for you in detail depends on the rest of your chart.

note: Dates are US Eastern time. Vedic (sidereal) astrology, read by Moon sign.
